definitions.agreement_site: An S node with adjacent NP subject and VP whose first word is tagged VBZ/VBP and belongs to an is/are, has/have, or does/do pair. Subject passes the same conservative filter as the DGP.
definitions.attractor: The eligible subject NP contains a direct PP with an opposite-number NP under the current conservative head rule.
definitions.paired_quote: A treebank opening `` and closing quote '' in one parsed sentence.
definitions.repeated_content: A case-insensitive alphabetic token of length at least four repeats within the sentence; this is a weak lexical proxy, not resolved coreference.

caveat: Counts are lexical/parse opportunities, not verified semantics or frequencies for FineWeb. The treebank does not provide a sampled document process.
